notes.title: Etheria: Restart - Official Launch Date Revealed!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42691362/b284a1ec1c84d4170fda44d8e8b6f0be88fcb35d.jpg
Etheria: Restart Official Launch - June 5, 2025

Dear Hyperlinkers,
Thank you for your continuous support and companionship~
Etheria: Restart will officially launch across all platforms on June 5, 2025, with pre-download available beforehand.

—— Welcome to the world of Etheria ——

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42691362/6c05aea74ff7ac78164a9714a9852643d9a84b3d.jpg

The Final Test for Etheria: Restart is about to start!

Test duration:
05:00, May 8 - 05:00, May 19 (UTC-5)
11:00, May 8 - 11:00, May 19 (UTC+1)
18:00, May 8 - 18:00, May 19 (UTC+8)

Platforms: 
Final Test supports Android, iOS, and PC with cross-progression

Test Type: 
Paid closed beta test with scheduled data wipes. Your accumulated purchases will be rebated once Etheria officially launches.

*Note: This test is not available in South Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau regions.

—— Final Test Direct Update ——

Check out the Final Test Direct Highlights below!
>> Launch Date Revealed
>> New Animuses & Bosses
>> New Gameplay & Events
>> RTA & EWS Global Invitational

notes.title: Etheria CBT is officially scheduled—recruitment is now open!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42691362/2cb449dae0a39e8ea4002ef06f1e8526b4f39953.jpg
Etheria CBT is officially scheduled—recruitment is now open!
Supernatural Hero Team-Building Turn-Based RPG

𝐓𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐨𝐝: January 9, 11:00 – January 20, 11:00 (UTC+8)
𝐏𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐬: iOS, Android, and PC (cross-platform data synchronization)
𝐓𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐓𝐲𝐩𝐞: Limited-access, data-wipe test (non-paid)

Sign Up: https://etheria.xd.com/us
 
------------------------
When a devastating global freeze threatens to extinguish human civilization, humanity transfers their consciousness into "Etheria," a virtual world, to preserve their legacy.

Within Etheria, humans coexist with beings known as the Animus, who wield mysterious Anima Powers. Their peaceful coexistence shatters when the "Genesis Virus" emerges, corrupting the Animus and driving them berserk, endangering humanity's survival. In response, the Hyperlinker Union forms to combat this threat.

Take on the role of a Hyperlinker and begin your adventure in Etheria.
 ------------------------
[Strategic Combat & Limitless Team Compositions]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42691362/bdcd6e2115af41e3859f61c971ec393915c7a4ac.jpg
Etheria evolves classic turn-based combat by incorporating diverse strategic mechanics and sandbox exploration, delivering a next-generation Team RPG experience! Create countless team combinations by synergizing Animus abilities, issue real-time combat commands, and freely control each Animus in battle. Master skill combinations and tactical setups to experience the thrill of overcoming powerful foes through superior strategy.
------------------------
[Breathtaking 3D Visuals & Cinematic Spectacle]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42691362/31f0f6027aaf9658d8657177bca72be6ea988247.jpg
Built in Unreal Engine, Etheria delivers cinematic immersion through lifelike lighting, detailed shadows, and fully rendered real-time scenes. Each character features unique combat animations enhanced by dynamic camera work and dazzling effects, creating spectacular battles without visual clutter or overwhelming effects.
------------------------
[Strategic PvP Arena Battles]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42691362/8830cd2ee924e8417ef17b3fb059e9dace2c03fa.jpg
Step into the Arena, where non-stop duels rage day and night! Engage in exhilarating PvP battles amid roaring crowds, showcase your unique strategies to fellow Hyperlinkers, and experience the pure thrill of tactical competition as you pursue your combat dreams!
------------------------
[Forge Your Combat Style]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42691362/588a824dc66c737b341d068eda09a6ebc0c767f6.jpg
Each Animus features a unique Prowess system with diverse progression paths. Customize their abilities through Shell equipment and nearly a hundred different Ether Module combinations to develop distinct fighting styles and combat approaches. Create specialized builds for your favorite Animus to tackle any battle scenario!
------------------------
[Discover Extraordinary Allies]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42691362/167cc21800ac7940214186e6aa0abad9a67e9391.jpg
Your journey through this virtual metropolis of danger and opportunity won't be lonely! Meet hundreds of unique Animus characters: a dual-wielding Reaper carrying a mighty coffin, a punk genius Hacker, a metropolitan Empress who manipulates Soul Flames... Join forces to confront unknown threats and unveil the mysteries of this futuristic city.
